summary: Verified Oracle deck 'endless spinner' bug fix end-to-end. Backend pytest (7/7 pass) confirms /api/oracle/draw latencies are well under the review-request bars: single-card 7.8s (<15s), three-card 14.3s (<25s), 5-card celtic 15.3s (<40s), and /api/oracle/chat 5.4s. Image cache is fully warm — 9/9 sampled draws returned cached image_base64. Overall narrative for 3-card is 367 words (in spec). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390×844) via public URL: admin logged in with math captcha, Single Card → Draw 1 Card resolved and rendered card + interpretation in 8.9s; Three Card Spread → Draw 3 Cards resolved in 16.1s network / 17.1s UI (repeat run 11.8s). All 3 cards render with image, element, name, interpretation, and the 'Reader's Full Vision' overall panel is present. 'Chat with Quantum AI' panel opens and displays the input; send-icon click did not fire a network request in my automation (icon-based button, not text) — chat itself is verified 200 OK via backend pytest. No React Native red screens; no console errors during the Oracle flows (only the pre-existing shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver/route-'files' warnings inherited from previous iterations).

Investigate the pre-existing '[Layout children]: No route named "files"' warning — either add the route or remove the stray reference.

Replace shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents props with modern boxShadow/textShadow/style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: oracle.py fix is clean and low-risk: get_or_generate_card_image now returns None on cache miss and schedules generation via asyncio.create_task — no fire-and-forget task leak because the task upserts and self-completes; identical concurrent requests are idempotent thanks to upsert-by-card_name.

_multi_card_readings_bundle wraps the JSON parse in try/except and falls back to the parallel two-step path — good defensive design; the fallback still lands under budget because both paths use gemini-2.5-flash.

datetime.utcnow() is used throughout /app/backend/routes/oracle.py (lines 277, 561, 611, 622, 670) — deprecated in Python 3.12+. Prefer datetime.now(timezone.utc). Not a bug now but worth cleaning during the next refactor.
oracle.py is 878 lines (over 700-line guideline) — consider splitting: cards data → oracle_cards.py, LLM helpers → oracle_readings.py, chat/TTS → oracle_chat.py.
SaveReadingRequest uses model_config={'extra': 'allow'} which is pragmatic but means unknown fields silently persist to Mongo — audit that clients don't PUSH _id or arbitrary junk.

rca_of_issue: Root cause was correctly identified by main agent: (1) inline gpt-image-1 calls on cache miss added 30-90s to /draw, (2) gemini-2.5-pro for interpretations added ~25s for a 3-card spread. Fix moved image gen to fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task (get_or_generate_card_image returns None on miss and schedules _synth_and_cache_card_image), moved all Madame Sable calls to gemini-2.5-flash, and consolidated per-card + overall vision into a single structured-JSON call via _multi_card_readings_bundle (with graceful two-step fallback). Verified live latencies: 7.8s / 14.3s / 15.3s / 5.4s (single/3-card/5-card draw, chat). No regressions in /oracle/chat or validation (missing reading → 400, empty question → 400).
